menu.lore: Grid collapse +14 months. Shortwave relays are failing across every continent. Ration your calories, chart passable corridors, fortify an outpost, and keep breathing.
menu.no_save_desc: No active survivor signals detected in this sector. Register your identity, customize your background, and begin your post-apocalyptic journey.
menu.footer_hint: ALL PROGRESS AUTOSAVED TO LOCAL TERMINAL

scavenger.name: Recon Scavenger
scavenger.desc: Starts with a courier duffel, lensatic compass, extra rations, and Lv.1 Recon & Scavenging.

medic.name: Field Medic
medic.desc: Starts with a trauma kit, antibiotics, chemical poncho, and Lv.1 Field Medicine.

engineer.name: Salvage Engineer
engineer.desc: Starts with a forged wrecking bar, steel plates, wiring, and Lv.1 Salvage Engineering.

veteran.name: Cordon Veteran
veteran.desc: Starts with a weighted machete, riding jacket, military rations, and Lv.1 Close Quarters.

character.create_subtitle: EMERGENCY PROTOCOL ACTIVE. CONFIGURE OPERATIVE IDENTITY, BIOMETRICS, AND DEPLOYMENT SECTOR.

step_subtitle.1: Step 1/4: Enter operative callsign, age, blood type, and primary survival disposition.
step_subtitle.2: Step 2/4: Select pre-collapse professional background and starting equipment kit.
step_subtitle.3: Step 3/4: Choose the insertion sector to commence survival operations.
step_subtitle.4: Step 4/4: Review survivor field dossier and initiate deployment.

stoic.name: Stoic
stoic.desc: High pain threshold; reduces panic and vitality loss from severe physical trauma.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.desc: Heightened sensory clarity during darkness; avoids nighttime disorientation.

fast_metabolism.name: Fast Metabolism
fast_metabolism.desc: +25% faster natural health regeneration when resting in safe structures.

hoarder.name: Hoarder
hoarder.desc: Master of efficient pack storage; permanently expands carrying capacity by +2.5 kg.

iron_stomach.name: Iron Stomach
iron_stomach.desc: Robust gastrointestinal immunity; halves infection risk from stale food and untreated water.

desc.scavenge_found: Scavenging in {location} yielded the following resources. Select which items to pack into your inventory:
desc.scavenge_empty: Thorough search in {location} found nothing of immediate use. The local scrap deposits may be depleted.
desc.combat_victory: {enemy} was neutralized (+{xp} XP). The following items were recovered from the hostile:
desc.combat_scavenge: You swiftly scavenged {enemy} while dodging. Found:

desc.survey_empty: Observation complete. No new uncharted sectors could be spotted from this vantage.
desc.rest: Rested securely for {hours} hours. Vital signs stabilized and energy reserves replenished.

hud.confirm_reset: Abandon current survivor and start a new expedition?

status.no_ailments: No acute bleeding, systemic infection, or musculoskeletal trauma detected.

bleeding.name: Laceration Hemorrhage
bleeding.desc: Steady blood loss each hour. Apply bandages or a field kit before shock sets in.

infection.name: Systemic Sepsis
infection.desc: Bacterial load climbing. Early stage can be fought off if well-fed; advanced stages require antiseptic or antibiotics.

sprain.name: Torn Ligament
sprain.desc: Slows overland travel significantly until splinted or rested.

foraging.name: Recon & Scavenging
foraging.desc: Increases salvage yield from ruins and improves evasion across collapsed terrain.

medical.name: Field Medicine
medical.desc: Amplifies healing and treatment potency; raises natural wound clotting odds.

engineering.name: Salvage Engineering
engineering.desc: Improves vehicle stripping, jury-rigging, and mechanical hazard resolution.

marksmanship.name: Close Quarters & Arms
marksmanship.desc: Raises tactical combat rating in hostile encounters.

inventory.overloaded_notice: OVERBURDENED — Overland travel slowed by 30% and stamina drain increased by 35%.
inventory.ground_empty: Nothing left on the ground at this sector.

map.no_direct_corridor: No direct route from current anchor

canned_beans.name: Tin of Navy Beans
canned_beans.desc: Dented steel can of salted beans in brine. Heavy, dependable calories.

jerky.name: Smoked Venison Strips
jerky.desc: Dry cured meat. Keeps forever, leaves your mouth parched.

mre.name: Sealed Field Ration (MRE)
mre.desc: Military-grade retort pouch with flameless heater and electrolyte pack.

energy_bar.name: Compressed Oat Bar
energy_bar.desc: Dense glucose and fat brick salvaged from an emergency kit.

bottled_water.name: Sealed Water Bottle
bottled_water.desc: Half-liter of clean, pre-collapse municipal water.

dirty_water.name: Brackish Runoff
dirty_water.desc: Cloudy water collected from cisterns. Quenches thirst at pathogen risk.

instant_coffee.name: Freeze-Dried Coffee Packet
instant_coffee.desc: Chewed dry or stirred into cold water to stave off exhaustion.

bandage.name: Sterile Gauze Roll
bandage.desc: Tightly woven pressure dressing that staunches active bleeding.

antiseptic.name: Iodine Tincture
antiseptic.desc: Stinging topical wash that scrubs down developing infections.

antibiotics.name: Broad-Spectrum Capsules
antibiotics.desc: Blister pack of ciprofloxacin. Purges systemic bacterial sepsis.

painkillers.name: Analgesic Tablets
painkillers.desc: Numbs musculoskeletal pain and restores short-term stamina.

first_aid_kit.name: Trauma Field Kit
first_aid_kit.desc: Hemostatic gauze, sutures, and staples. Restores integrity and halts bleeding.

kitchen_knife.name: Full-Tang Chef Knife
kitchen_knife.desc: Carbon-steel blade wrapped in cord. Better than bare knuckles.

crowbar.name: Forged Wrecking Bar
crowbar.desc: Pries locked trunks (+12% search chance) and cracks skulls.

machete.name: Weighted Brush Machete
machete.desc: Long agricultural blade suited for close quarters.

fire_axe.name: Municipal Fire Axe
fire_axe.desc: Fiberglass-handled breaching axe (+8% search chance, high impact).

hunting_rifle.name: Bolt-Action .308 Rifle
hunting_rifle.desc: Long-range rifle. Requires .308 cartridges to fire at full rating.

rifle_rounds.name: .308 Brass Cartridges
rifle_rounds.desc: Boxed centerfire ammunition for bolt-action rifles.

scrap_metal.name: Sheared Steel Plate
scrap_metal.desc: Salvaged structural metal for fortifications and toolsmithing.

copper_wire.name: Spool of Copper Wire
copper_wire.desc: Stripped windings used in traps, radios, and repairs.

electronics.name: Salvaged Circuitry
electronics.desc: Intact relays, capacitors, and logic boards.

cloth_rags.name: Torn Canvas Strips
cloth_rags.desc: Cleanable fabric scraps for bindings and filters.

duct_tape.name: Industrial Cloth Tape
duct_tape.desc: Reinforced adhesive roll that holds the post-collapse world together.

duffel_bag.name: Canvas Courier Duffel
duffel_bag.desc: Slung over one shoulder (+6 kg capacity, +3 slots).

hiking_pack.name: Internal-Frame Trekker Pack
hiking_pack.desc: Distributes weight across the hips (+12 kg capacity, +5 slots).

military_rucksack.name: MOLLE Patrol Rucksack
military_rucksack.desc: Heavy expedition rig (+18 kg capacity, +8 slots).

leather_jacket.name: Abrasion Riding Jacket
leather_jacket.desc: Thick cowhide that turns teeth and rusty shards (+1 armor).

hazmat_poncho.name: Polymer Chemical Poncho
hazmat_poncho.desc: Heat-sealed seams shed caustic fallout and acid rain.

riot_vest.name: Plated Riot Harness
riot_vest.desc: Polycarbonate trauma plates over ballistic weave (+3 armor).

flashlight.name: Dynamo Angle Torch
flashlight.desc: Hand-cranked beam that cuts night travel risk and aids indoor searches (+4%).

compass.name: Liquid Lensatic Compass
compass.desc: Keeps true bearing across dead highways (+8% overland pace).

abandoned_car.title: Jackknifed Convoy Sedan
abandoned_car.text: A dust-choked sedan sits wedged against a jersey barrier. The trunk latch is sprung and the wiring harness hangs below the dash.

outcome.search: You pry open the trunk and rake through scattered emergency supplies.
outcome.strip_success: You cleanly sever the harness and pull intact electronics from the dash.
outcome.strip_failure: A rusted bracket snaps under tension and slices across your forearm.
outcome.leave: You bypass the wreck without breaking stride.

feral_dogs.title: Starved Pack on the Ridge
feral_dogs.text: Three rib-thin hounds fan out across the rubble ahead, hackles raised and jaws flecked with foam.

choice.stand: Hold ground and drive them off
choice.feed: Toss a ration to break their focus

outcome.stand_success: A decisive strike drops the lead hound; the pack scatters into the drainage ditch.
outcome.stand_failure: Teeth sink into your calf before you wrench free and club them back.
outcome.feed: The pack snaps over the thrown food while you slip two blocks downwind.
outcome.flee_success: You vault the rebar wall and lose them through a collapsed courtyard.
outcome.flee_failure: Loose brick gives way under your boot; the pack mauls your leg as you pull free.

raider_toll.title: Barricade Checkpoint
raider_toll.text: Armed scavengers step out from behind a burned bus, demanding rations for safe passage through the interchange.

choice.pay: Hand over two rations of food or water
choice.fight: Break through the barricade by force
choice.barter: Offer to repair their jammed generator

outcome.pay: They weigh your pouches, wave you through the wire, and watch until you clear the block.
outcome.fight_success: You drop the point man and strip his rig before the others retreat into the smoke.
outcome.fight_failure: Buckshot and shrapnel tear into your side as you fight your way clear.
outcome.barter_success: You clean the fouled injector; impressed, they toss you two oat bars and wave you on.
outcome.barter_failure: Your fix backfires in a shower of sparks. They beat you with rifle butts before shoving you out.

collapsed_overpass.title: Pancaked Highway Span
collapsed_overpass.text: Concrete slabs block the main corridor, leaving a treacherous tangle of rebar or a long detour around the basin.

choice.climb: Pick a route straight over the slabs

outcome.climb_success: You test each slab and crest the rubble without losing time.
outcome.climb_failure: A slab shifts underfoot, wrenching your ankle as you slide down the scree.
outcome.detour: You spend hours skirting flooded underpasses before rejoining the route.

acid_rain.title: Sulfa Squall on the Horizon
acid_rain.text: Yellow-gray clouds bruise the sky and the first oily drops hiss against rusted sheet metal.

choice.shelter: Wait out the squall under a concrete culvert
choice.push_on: Pull up your collar and march through it

outcome.shelter: You huddle beneath concrete until the caustic runoff subsides.
outcome.push_on_success: Your sealed poncho sheds the acidic downpour without a burn.
outcome.push_on_failure: Caustic rain soaks through your sleeves, blistering exposed skin.

supply_cache.title: Tripwire Civil-Defense Locker
supply_cache.text: Behind a false basement wall sits a stenciled relief crate — wired to a makeshift spring gun.

choice.open: Disarm the wire and crack the crate
choice.leave: Back away slowly and leave it

outcome.open_success: You crimp the tension wire and lift the lid on untouched emergency stock.
outcome.open_failure: The wire slips — a rusted bolt fires across your thigh before the latch gives.
outcome.leave: You mark the cellar on your mental map and leave the trap untouched.

rusted_debris.title: Shifting Steel Joists
rusted_debris.text: A promising storeroom lies pinned beneath a groaned web of corroded roof trusses.

choice.careful: Shore the beam andworm through carefully
choice.force: Wrench the sheet metal clear by brute force

outcome.careful_success: You slip beneath the truss and clear the passage without disturbing the load.
outcome.careful_failure: Jagged flashing drops from the ceiling, raking across your shoulder.
outcome.force: You tear free a slab of steel plate at the cost of scraped knuckles.

storm_at_sea.title: Cross-Swell Squall
storm_at_sea.text: Black swells hammer the hull and freezing spray floods the bilge halfway across the strait.

choice.ride_out: Lash the tiller and ride out the squall
choice.turn_back: Come about and run back for the departure port

outcome.ride_out_success: You keep the bow quartering the waves until the squall breaks.
outcome.ride_out_failure: A breaking crest slams the gunwale, washing gear overboard and bruising your ribs.
outcome.turn_back: You fight the rudder hard over and limp back to shore.

lone_survivor.title: Feverish Courier by the Tracks
lone_survivor.text: A gaunt courier sits propped against a signal box, clutching an empty canteen and a medic pouch.

choice.share: Spare a ration or bottle of water
choice.ignore: Give a wide berth and keep walking

outcome.share: Grateful, they press a handful of medical supplies into your palm before parting ways.
outcome.ignore: You keep your hand on your weapon and pass without a word.

night_prowler.title: Footsteps Outside the Bivouac
night_prowler.text: Gravel crunches in the dark just beyond your shelter doorway; someone is testing the latch.

choice.confront: Lunging into the doorway with weapon raised
choice.hide: Kill your light and slip into the crawlspace

outcome.confront_success: You catch the intruder off-balance and drive them scrambling into the alley.
outcome.confront_failure: A blade flashes in the dark, catching your ribs before the prowler bolts.
outcome.hide_success: The prowler sweeps the empty room and moves on empty-handed.
outcome.hide_failure: You stay hidden, but they snatch a pouch from the floor on their way out.

radio_static.title: Shortwave Carrier Burst
radio_static.text: A solarrepeater atop a utility pole clicks to life, broadcasting automated weather beacons from distant sectors.

choice.listen: Log the coordinates from the carrier loop (30m)
choice.ignore: Save the daylight and move on

outcome.listen: You copy down grid bearings for distant transit hubs before the carrier fades.
outcome.ignore: You leave the repeater clicking into the wind.

boot.awakened: Cold static clears. You check your straps in the ruins of {location}.

health.low: Your vision narrows; blood and bruising slow every movement.
health.critical: Integrity critical — another hard hit will put you under.

satiety.critical: Severe caloric deficit; muscle tremor setting in.

hydration.low: Your tongue is dry and cracked.
hydration.critical: Severe dehydration — dizziness and kidney ache.

energy.critical: Stamina nearly spent; every step drags.
energy.depleted: Complete exhaustion — you are stumbling on sheer reflex.

bleeding.worse: Hemorrhage worsens as the wound tears open.
bleeding.stopped: The bleeding finally clots on its own.

infection.worse: Bacterial load spikes inside the wound.
infection.symptomatic: Fever and chills take hold as sepsis turns symptomatic.
infection.severe: Delirium and septic shock setting in!
infection.cleared: Your immune system clears the lingering infection.
infection.treated: Antiseptic wash drives the infection back.

inventory.left_behind: Pack full — left {item} (×{count}) on the ground.
inventory.nothing_to_lose: Nothing in your pack could be taken.

scavenge.started: Combing the ruins of {location} for salvage...
scavenge.empty: Picked through collapsed structures in {location} and came up empty.

survey.nothing: Perimeters around {location} are already fully charted.

rest.started: Barricaded a corner in {location} for {hours}h of rest.

base.water_collected: Rainwater collector filtered ×{count} clean water into outpost storage.

feral_hound.name: Rabid Feral Hound
feral_hound.desc: Gaunt, scarred pack predator lunging through the rubble with bared fangs.

raider_scout.name: Highway Scavenger Raider
raider_scout.desc: Outrider armed with a notched machete and welded scrap armor.

plague_stalker.name: Fevered Zone Stalker
plague_stalker.desc: Delirious carrier coated in septic grime, lashing out blindly.

cordon_deserter.name: Rogue Cordon Deserter
cordon_deserter.desc: Former perimeter trooper in battered ballistic rig carrying a service weapon.

combat.fled_success: Broke contact and slipped away from {name}.

base.none_established: No permanent outpost established. Claim your current sector to build workstations and storage.

workbench.name: Field Workbench
workbench.desc: Unlocks Tier I and Tier II fabrication schematics at this outpost.

rain_catcher.name: Atmospheric Condenser & Tarp
rain_catcher.desc: Passively filters clean water into the outpost stockpile over time.

barricade.name: Rebar & Sheet-Metal Barricade
barricade.desc: Fortifies the shelter perimeter against night prowlers and raids.

med_cot.name: Sterile Field Cot
med_cot.desc: Accelerates physical integrity recovery while resting at the outpost.

reject.in_combat: Resolve the active combat engagement first.

death.title: SIGNAL TERMINATED

cause.acid: Chemical burns from caustic fallout proved fatal.
cause.drowning: Swallowed by storm swells in open water.
cause.wounds: Fell to cumulative trauma in the field.

death.summary: Survived {days} days across {nodes} charted sectors. Final transmission logged at {location}.
